summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Xtrackers S&P MidCap 400 Scored & Screened ETF (MIDE) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the S&P MidCap 400 ESG index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of US mid-cap companies with favorable ESG ratings. MIDE was launched on Feb 24, 2021 and is issued by Xtrackers.

holdings.infoBox: MIDE is an equity ETF with a total of 267 individual holdings. The top holdings are Okta, Inc. stock at 1.72%, TechnipFMC at 1.21%, nVent Electric at 1.20%, Entegris at 1.13%, and Mcr Em S&P Sc 400 Dec26 at 1.10%.
